title: Custom Items Plugin
description: Build custom RPG items with 50+ abilities and every stat bonus and armor sets in-game!
body:
⚔️ CustomItems: The Ultimate Ability Engine
CustomItems isn't just another enchantment plugin—it's a comprehensive item-editor suite that allows you to imbue your gear with over 40+ unique, levelable abilities and set bonuses. Designed for server owners and creators who want total control over their gear progression, it features a unique, streamlined interface and a powerful data-driven backend.

🚀 Key Features
⚡ 40+ Unique Abilities: From combat-altering powers like Lifesteal, Lightning, and Execute to utility must-haves like Veinminer, Magnet, and Blink.

🛡️ Set Bonuses & Attributes: Create specialized gear sets that provide buffs when worn together. Modify base attributes like speed, health, and damage directly.

🎨 Intuitive Editor GUI: Access the "Creator" menu via /ci to manage your item's powers without memorizing complex NBT tags or commands.

💾 Item Saving & Sharing: Use /ci save <name> to store your masterpieces in the config and /ci give <name> to distribute them to players or loot chests.

🛠️ Commands
/ci — Opens the Item Creator GUI and shows help.

/ci reload — Instantly refreshes all ability, set, and item configurations.

/ci save <name> — Saves the item in your hand to the plugin storage.

/ci give <name> — Spawns a previously saved custom item.

📖 How to Use
Hold the item you want to modify in your main hand.

Type /ci to open the Editor.

Select Abilities, Attributes, or Sets.

Click an option in the menu—the GUI will close, allowing you to type the desired level or value directly into chat.

Your item is updated instantly with custom lore and Roman numeral formatting!

CustomItems is built for Spigot/Paper 1.21.1+ and requires zero external dependencies. Perfect for RPG, Factions, or Survival servers looking for that "Extra" edge.
